statement_summary: Maintain a written information security program (POL-01, P02, P01)
Owner designated in writing as program coordinator and privacy contact
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30 and after major changes
Risk decision rules; High risks never accepted as they are
Annual testing, monthly monitoring, outside review every second year
Annual evaluation and update of the program
Online children's privacy notice linked from home page, sign-in page, and each collection form
Direct notice and verifiable parental consent before an account or recording
New notice and consent before any material change
No disclosure of children's information to third parties
Collect only what the activity needs; analytics off in the members area
Parent review, deletion, and refusal requests answered within 10 business days
Record sessions only with consent on file; 30-day deletion
No written assurances, no children's data
Vendor list with data held and assurances
Annual review of the client-management SaaS SOC 2 report and customer controls
Owner-started, watched remote support; unattended access off
Named accounts; no shared credentials; no family use of the owner's account
MFA on every service that offers it
Unique 14-character passphrases in a password manager
Parents set portal passwords; no list kept
Close portal accounts within 30 days; remove contractor collaborators; term review
Named-parent file sharing only
Monthly sign-in history review
Device lock after 5 minutes (phone 1 minute)
Three-level data classification
Restricted data only in approved systems
Full-disk encryption on every device
No progress information by ordinary text
Backup of student folders that sync cannot overwrite
Retention schedule; nothing kept indefinitely; term-end deletion log
Shredding; device wipe or certified destruction with a record
Business devices for business work; separate family account
Automatic updates and antivirus stay on
Unique router password; guest network; hotspot away from home
No student information in AI tools; owner makes every decision about a student
Annual security training for the owner
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery time
Meet the notice deadlines in the P08 matrix
No ransom without counsel and an OFAC check
